requirements.requirement: Current and historical feedback; ordinary learning all outcomes, failure-only optional investigation
Full six-arm, six-case, 36-stream matrix; 48 chronological tasks and cold24/continued24 without reset
RP/R only failure-reward difference; F has a real reward-free update and no reward-derived prior
evidence: all native LEARN packet and binary64 TD records

requirements.requirement: Matched basic learner, observations, action/edit capabilities and actual cost reporting
Authentic issued observations, own-source once consumption, no copied private learning state
Planned early/target/cost/error/cold-warm metrics and actual curves; preserve censored results
Finite local CPU study within native/step/time/capture ceilings, no old run or formal collection
Separate result-neutral conclusions; preserve first errors, negative and zero results

joint_candidate_scope: Common source-defined grammar; not triggered in this matrix, no multi-position qualification claimed.
scope_limits: Pure feedback retains task goal and visible outcome labels; it is not goal-free or prior-free.
F uses a model-based categorical planner while RP/R use Q heads; cross-family results are whole-method comparisons.
S uses a hand-declared experiment-order rule plus a learned current-source query index, not a trained general causal/value model.
Exact query reuse is valid in this deterministic unchanged world; stochastic settings require a new contract.
Both command outcomes are reachable in the initial swap; all groups have the same local repair capability.
Increased depth also lengthens propagation from the same terminal reward rule; not a separate causal identification of every kind of complexity.
After-24 observations reuse the same environment; not unseen-family transfer.
Runtime is instrumented local CPU with capture/tracemalloc; Python traced heap is not full process RSS; no all-resource dominance claim.
